findings.claim: Original editor workspace-object creation 00409840 allocates a 0x78-byte payload through CRT _malloc, while linked-list insertion 0041C430 separately allocates a 0x0c-byte node through HeapAlloc, establishing distinct ownership and release pathways.
findings.limitations: Creation allocations are established by original binary instructions/decompilation, but creation itself was not originally emulated this iteration.

findings.claim: Original deleted-zone traversal 00409DC0 caches node+0 next pointer prior to destruction; original 00409A60 unlinks and frees the node via 0041C480 then CRT-frees node+8 object payload independently. Two-node native original-code deletion confirmed sequential node/payload release event ordering.
findings.limitations: Windows HeapFree and CRT heap lookup/free internals were isolated; real heap memory ownership and Windows UI not executed.

findings.claim: Original CRT _free at 00422FA0 calls 00425260 small-block lookup; nonzero result branches to 004252C0 small-block release, while zero result falls back to IAT HeapFree using CRT heap handle 016424F0. Both original x86 branch paths executed for two deleted payloads with controlled lookup outcomes.
findings.limitations: Lookup success/failure, CRT _sbh_free_block service and Windows HeapFree were substituted; actual retail allocation class for each payload unmeasured.

findings.claim: Original zone release/compaction with two deleted-zone and two moved-zone synthetic objects completed through native destructor/list code under both CRT heap branch alternatives. 87/87 plane, metadata, map and moved-object reference assertions passed; surviving zone payload IDs rebind 2 to 1 and original allocator reuses slot 2.
findings.limitations: Well-formed synthetic lists only; local Ghidra emulator uses isolated external heap/status/display/Windows callbacks, and full heap safety not proven.

findings.claim: Original 00409A60 contains only node unlink, node HeapFree and CRT _free(payload); no recursive nested model/texture resource release appears in this function. This editor record lifetime must be distinguished from retail-game scene or vehicle object resource lifetimes.
findings.limitations: This is the bounded 00409A60 original-code path; other owners or resources reachable elsewhere are not excluded.
